## Workspace guidance

- Keep the site build-free and deployable on any static host.
- Use semantic HTML, accessible interactions, and responsive CSS.
- Do not collect submissions until the placeholder Formspree endpoint has been configured.
- Keep setup and deployment instructions current in `README.md`.
